name: Cedric AI
summary: AI teammate that joins meetings, presents slides, takes notes and completes follow-ups with approval.
description: Cedric is a shared AI employee for teams: it joins Google Meet/Zoom/Teams calls, can present decks slide-by-slide, posts recaps, drafts follow-ups and works in Slack/Discord/Telegram with a shared company memory and 3,000+ tool connections. Swiss-based; asks before sending anything outward. Workspaces start with 100,000 free credits ($50) with no card; Starter $19/month; Max $99/month — plans differ by credit volume only.
features: Joins Google Meet, Zoom and Teams calls
Works in Slack, Discord and Telegram
Shared company memory and 3,000+ tool connections
